accumulatorBane.name: Accumulator [Bane]
accumulatorBane.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Bane warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

acidBlast.name: Acid Blast
acidBlast.description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 corrosion blast damage roll and the corrosion continuous effect.

acidicMist.name: Acidic Mist
acidicMist.description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Corrosion suffer -2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

acidicTouch.name: Acidic Touch
acidicTouch.description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Corrosion and its melee weapons gain the Continuous Effect: Corrosion. Acidic Touch lasts for one round.

adrenalineRush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenalineRush.description: Monstrosities in Cyphon’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain +3 SPD and ARM and +3 to their melee attack damage rolls for one round.

adrenalSurge.name: Adrenal Surge
adrenalSurge.description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

aggressive.name: Aggressive
aggressive.description: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.

agonies.name: Agonies
agonies.description: Once at any time during its activation, this model can be forced to use one of the following effects: Gnawing Pain or Maddening or Spiritual Affliction.

alchemicalMask.name: Alchemical Mask
alchemicalMask.description: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.

anatomicalPrecision.name: Anatomical Precision
anatomicalPrecision.description: When this model's melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

ancillaryAttackAction.name: Ancillary Attack (★Action)
ancillaryAttackAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by an Ancillary Attack special action only once per turn.

anesthesia.name: Anesthesia
anesthesia.description: A living model damaged by an attack with this weapon becomes stationary for one round.

annihilator.name: Annihilator
annihilator.description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls against living models. When a living model is destroyed within 3" of this model, it never generates a soul token.

apparition.name: Apparition
apparition.description: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.

arcaneAssist.name: Arcane Assist
arcaneAssist.description: If its Leader is within 5" of this model during your Control Phase, the Leader can upkeep one spell without spending a focus or fury point.

arcaneSuppression.name: Arcane Suppression
arcaneSuppression.description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Arcane Suppression lasts for one round.

arcingFire.name: Arcing Fire
arcingFire.description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.

armorPiercing.name: Armor-Piercing
armorPiercing.description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

armorPiercingAttack.name: Armor-Piercing (★Attack)
armorPiercingAttack.description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

artificeOfDomination.name: Artifice of Domination
artificeOfDomination.description: When this model hits an enemy model with an attack, it gains a mind token. This model can have up to 5 mind tokens on it at any time. This model can spend mind tokens for the following: Mental Reservoir - During its Combat Action, this model can spend mind tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent. Manifest Control - After this model casts a spell, it can spend a mind token to cast a spell it has not already cast this turn.

attached.name: Attached
attached.description: Before the start of the game, attach this model to a friendly Faction Leader for the rest of the game. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it. The attached model is part of its Leader's battlegroup.

attachmentBaneWarrior.name: Attachment [Bane Warrior]
attachmentBaneWarrior.description: This attachment can be added to a Bane Warrior unit.

attackType.name: Attack Type
attackType.description: Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules: Black Humor - This weapon gains Continuous Effect: Corrosion and Grievous Wounds for this attack. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.) Experimental Warhead - Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire and Corrosion continuous effects. Spontaneous Combustion - On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon's damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.

baneWitchAgathiaFeat.name: Shadowfall
baneWitchAgathiaFeat.description: Models in Agathia's battlegroup currently in her control range are affected by Ghost Walk. Additionally, you can place each friendly faction Cohort model currently in Agathia's control range anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadowfall lasts for one turn.

banish.name: Banish
banish.description: When this weapon damages an enemy non-Leader model, immediately after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 1" of its current location.

battleDriven.name: Battle-Driven
battleDriven.description: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gains +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

battlePlan.name: Battle Plan
battlePlan.description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation: Precision Strike - While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn. Special Orders - RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]'s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.) Tenacity - RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Feign Death for one round. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

battleWizard.name: Battle Wizard
battleWizard.description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

beastMasterXekaarFeat.name: Whispers of Torment
beastMasterXekaarFeat.description: While in Xekaar's control range, enemy models suffer -3 MAT, RAT, and THR. Additionally, affected models suffer -3 to their melee attack damage rolls. Whispers of Torment lasts for one round.

beatBack.name: Beat Back
beatBack.description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model's Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

befuddleAttack.name: Befuddle (★Attack)
befuddleAttack.description: Befuddle is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

bewitch.name: Bewitch
bewitch.description: After this attack has been resolved, take control of target living enemy non-Leader warrior model hit by this attack. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Bewitch expires. A model can be affected by Bewitch only once per turn.

blackArts.name: Black Arts
blackArts.description: A friendly Faction Leader model that has this model in its control range can upkeep one spell without spending focus or fury.

bloodBoon.name: Blood Boon
bloodBoon.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending focus or fury points.

bloodShadow.name: Blood Shadow
bloodShadow.description: If this attack boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.

bodySnatcherGraveRobber5.name: Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [5"]
bodySnatcherGraveRobber5.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When an enemy living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. When a friendly living model is destroyed by a continuous effect, an enemy attack, or collateral damage from an enemy attack while within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for Death Industry.

bodySnatcherHarvester.name: Body Snatcher: Harvester
bodySnatcherHarvester.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead friendly model is destroyed by an enemy attack within 8" of this model or when a living or undead enemy model is destroyed within 8" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following: Death Feast - During its activation, this model can spend corpse tokens to remove d3 damage points for each token spent. Meat for the Beast - During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent. Thrall Crafting - Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to put one friendly Corpse Crawler into play for each token spent. You can have up to three friendly Corpse Crawlers in play at any time for each friendly Necroharvester in play. Place the Crawlers B2B with this model.

bodySnatcherHeartEater.name: Body Snatcher: Heart Eater
bodySnatcherHeartEater.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for Crucible of Death.

bondDeneghra.name: Bond [Deneghra]
bondDeneghra.description: If Nightmare begins the game in Deneghra's battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Nightmare is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Nightmare is bonded to Deneghra and in her control range, it gains Stealth.

bondMordikaar.name: Bond [Mordikaar]
bondMordikaar.description: If Despoiler begins the game in Mordikaar's battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Despoiler is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Despoiler is bonded to Mordikaar and in his control range, once per turn when a living enemy warrior model is boxed while within 5" of this model, remove the boxed model from play and replace it with a friendly Void Spirit model.

bondScaverous.name: Bond [Scaverous]
bondScaverous.description: If this model begins the game in Scaverous' battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to Scaverous and in his control range, he can channel spells through it.

bondXekaar.name: Bond [Xekaar]
bondXekaar.description: If Chiron begins the game in Xekaar's battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Chiron is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Chiron is bonded to Xekaar and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

boneyard.name: Boneyard
boneyard.description: Models in Eviscerus' battlegroup currently in his control range become Dug In. Then, models in Eviscerus' battlegroup currently in his control range gain Burial Rites. (A dug in model has cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.) (A model with Burial Rites gains +2 SPD and one focus point at the start of each activation in which it begins Dug In. A model loses Burial Rites for the rest of the game the next time it ceases to be Dug In.)

bothBarrels.name: Both Barrels
bothBarrels.description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

bothBarrelsAttack.name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
bothBarrelsAttack.description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

boundingLeap.name: Bounding Leap
boundingLeap.description: Once per activation, after making a full advance as its Normal Movement but before performing its Combat Action, this model can spend 1 focus point to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

brainDamage.name: Brain Damage
brainDamage.description: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

breathTaker.name: Breath Taker
breathTaker.description: Living enemy models suffer -2 DEF and -2 to their melee attack damage rolls while within 5" of this model.

brutalCharge.name: Brutal Charge
brutalCharge.description: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.

brutalDamage.name: Brutal Damage
brutalDamage.description: On a direct hit, gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against the target directly hit.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

burster.name: Burster
burster.description: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, the closest three enemy models within 3" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After this damage is resolved, remove the boxed model from play.

bushwhack.name: Bushwhack
bushwhack.description: During its activation, a model with Bushwhack can make its Combat Action before its Normal Movement. If it does, it must make a full advance as its Normal Movement that activation.

carapace.name: Carapace
carapace.description: This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.

carapaceGrenades.name: Carapace Grenades
carapaceGrenades.description: Once per turn when this model is hit by a melee attack, after the attack has been resolved this model can use Carapace Grenades. When it does so, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll. This model loses Carapace Grenades while its S system is crippled.

cerebralChanneling.name: Cerebral Channeling
cerebralChanneling.description: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it. After a spell has been channeled through this model it becomes disabled.

chainAttackDeathChill.name: Chain Attack: Death Chill
chainAttackDeathChill.description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, the model hit becomes stationary for one round.

chainAttackGrabSmash.name: Chain Attack: Grab & Smash
chainAttackGrabSmash.description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately make a head-butt or throw power attack against that model even if it charged that activation.

channeler.name: Channeler
channeler.description: While a model with Channeler is in a friendly Faction Leader's control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.

chokingAsh.name: Choking Ash
chokingAsh.description: On a direct hit, living warrior models hit cannot run or charge for one round unless they can ignore gas effects.

chopShop.name: Chop Shop
chopShop.description: When a model in this model's battlegroup destroys an enemy construct model with a melee attack, remove d3 +1 damage points from one model in this model's battlegroup currently in its control range and remove the destroyed model from play.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.

combatDrugs.name: Combat Drugs
combatDrugs.description: RNG 5. Target Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gains Aggressive for one turn. (A model with Aggressive can run or charge without spending a focus point or being forced.)

combatDrugsAction.name: Combat Drugs (★Action)
combatDrugsAction.description: RNG 5. Target Cohort in this model's battlegroup gains Aggressive for one turn. (A model with Aggressive can run or charge without spending a focus point or being forced.)

comboStrike.name: Combo Strike
comboStrike.description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack.

comboStrikeAttack.name: Combo Strike (★Attack)
comboStrikeAttack.description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack.

commandAttachmentBaneKnight.name: Command Attachment [Bane Knight]
commandAttachmentBaneKnight.description: This command attachment can be added to a Bane Knight unit.

commandAttachmentImmortals.name: Command Attachment [Immortals]
commandAttachmentImmortals.description: This command attachment can be added to an Immortal unit.

commandAttachmentSmallBasedDrudge.name: Command Attachment [Small-based Drudge]
commandAttachmentSmallBasedDrudge.description: This command attachment can be added to a small based Drudge unit.

companionCarverUltimus.name: Companion [Carver Ultimus]
companionCarverUltimus.description: This model is included in any army that includes Carver Ultimus. If Carver is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Carver's battlegroup.

companionExulonNostilla.name: Companion [Exulon Nostilla]
companionExulonNostilla.description: This model is included in any army that includes Exulon Nostilla. If Nostilla is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Nostilla's battlegroup.

companionGoreshadeTheBastard.name: Companion [Goreshade The Bastard]
companionGoreshadeTheBastard.description: This model is included in any army that includes Goreshade The Bastard. If Goreshade is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Goreshade's battlegroup.

companionMagnusTheUnstoppable.name: Companion [Magnus, the Unstoppable]
companionMagnusTheUnstoppable.description: This model is included in any army that includes Magnus, the Unstoppable. If Magnus is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Magnus' battlegroup.

conditionAction.name: Condition (★ Action)
conditionAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

counterblast.name: Counterblast
counterblast.description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 5" of the spellcaster, the spellcaster can make one basic melee or ranged attack targeting that model, then Counterblast expires. Counterblast lasts for one round.

craftTalismanAction.name: Craft Talisman (★ Action)
craftTalismanAction.description: RNG 5. Target a friendly Leader model. If the Leader is in range, when it casts a spell and is the point of origin, the spell gains +2 RNG. Spells with RNG SELF or CTRL are not affected. Craft Talisman lasts for one turn.

created.name: Created
created.description: This model does not begin the game in play.

createScrapThrallAction.name: Create Scrap Thrall (★ Action)
createScrapThrallAction.description: Remove one or more scrap tokens from this model, then roll a d3 for each scrap token removed. Place up to that number of Scrap Thralls into play completely within 3" of this model. A placed Scrap Thrall must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

criticalArmorPiercing.name: Critical Armor-Piercing
criticalArmorPiercing.description: On a critical hit, when calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of the model hit.

criticalBrutalDamage.name: Critical Brutal Damage
criticalBrutalDamage.description: On a critical hit, gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against the target directly hit.

criticalDecapitation.name: Critical Decapitation
criticalDecapitation.description: On a critical hit, double the damage exceeding the ARM of the model hit. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.

criticalGrievousWounds.name: Critical Grievous Wounds
criticalGrievousWounds.description: On a critical hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

criticalKnockdown.name: Critical Knockdown
criticalKnockdown.description: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

criticalParalysis.name: Critical Paralysis
criticalParalysis.description: On a critical hit, a living model hit has its base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

criticalPitch.name: Critical Pitch
criticalPitch.description: On a critical hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit can be thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

criticalPoison.name: Critical Poison
criticalPoison.description: On a critical hit, gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against living models.

criticalShred.name: Critical Shred
criticalShred.description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model's Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

criticalSmite.name: Critical Smite
criticalSmite.description: On a critical hit, the model hit can be slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model, it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.

crucibleOfDeath.name: Crucible of Death
crucibleOfDeath.description: This model can spend up to three corpse tokens at the start of its activation to gain 1 focus point for each corpse token spent.

cryxianMonstrosity.name: Cryxian Monstrosity
cryxianMonstrosity.description: This model is a monstrosity that can be included in a Cryxian warcaster's battlegroup. A Cryxian warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. A Cryxian warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Cryxian monstrosity. To do this, a Cryxian warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Cryxian monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it. At any time during its activation, a Cryxian warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.

cumbersome.name: Cumbersome
cumbersome.description: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.

curseBane.name: Curse [Bane]
curseBane.description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Friendly Bane models gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

darkBlessing.name: Dark Blessing
darkBlessing.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to gain +3 DEF. Dark Blessing lasts for one round.

darkDomination.name: Dark Domination
darkDomination.description: When this model hits an enemy warjack that has a non-crippled cortex with a basic melee attack made with this weapon during this model's activation, you can take control of the warjack. Immediately after the attack has been resolved, you can make a full advance with the warjack and can then make one basic attack, then Dark Domination expires. A warjack can be affected by Dark Domination only once per turn.

darkFireAttack.name: Dark Fire (★Attack)
darkFireAttack.description: Dark Fire is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

darkRestoration.name: Dark Restoration
darkRestoration.description: If Goreshade is disabled while within 5" of this model, this model is destroyed and 1 damage point is removed from Goreshade.

darkShroud.name: Dark Shroud
darkShroud.description: While within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer -2 ARM.

darkWhispers.name: Dark Whispers
darkWhispers.description: This model can cast a spell with COST 3 or less without spending focus.

deathBurstAttack.name: Death Burst (★ Attack)
deathBurstAttack.description: This weapon's POW becomes 16 when resolving this attack, and models other than the target of this attack within 2" of this model suffer a POW 8 blast damage roll. After this attack is resolved, remove this model from play.

deathIndustry.name: Death Industry
deathIndustry.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction undead Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within 12" of this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

deathPowered.name: Death-Powered
deathPowered.description: This model gains +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls for each corpse token currently on it.

deathRideAction.name: Death Ride (★ Action)
deathRideAction.description: Friendly Faction undead models activating within 5" of this model gain +1" movement when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Death Ride lasts for one turn.

deathTollMechanithrall.name: Death Toll [Mechanithrall]
deathTollMechanithrall.description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly small-based Mechanithrall unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

deathTollSmallBasedBane.name: Death Toll [small-based Bane]
deathTollSmallBasedBane.description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly small-based Bane unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

deathwalk.name: Deathwalk
deathwalk.description: When this model boxes a living enemy warrior model with an attack with this weapon and the Deathwalker is not in play, remove the boxed model from play and replace it with the Deathwalker.

debrisField.name: Debris Field
debrisField.description: Enemy models treat open terrain within 4" of this model as rough terrain.

defenseFormation.name: Defense Formation
defenseFormation.description: While in this model’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in this model's battlegroup with an extra-large base or smaller gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down.

defensiveStrike.name: Defensive Strike
defensiveStrike.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model's melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

deneghraTheSoulWeaverFeat.name: Hell Gate
deneghraTheSoulWeaverFeat.description: Deneghra immediately gains seven soul tokens.

desperateMissionAction.name: Desperate Mission (★Action)
desperateMissionAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Last Word. Desperate Mission lasts for one round. (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

desperatePaceImmortal.name: Desperate Pace [Immortal]
desperatePaceImmortal.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Immortal trooper model. If the model is in range, the models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

devourSoul.name: Devour Soul
devourSoul.description: When this model destroys a living enemy model with this weapon and generates a soul token, you can choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model's soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models cannot gain soul tokens from models destroyed by this weapon.

digIn.name: Dig In
digIn.description: A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.

digInAction.name: Dig In (★Action)
digInAction.description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

directSpirits.name: Direct Spirits
directSpirits.description: When a friendly living Faction warrior model is destroyed within 10" of this model and generates a soul token, you choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model's soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from friendly models destroyed within 10" of this model.

distillation.name: Distillation
distillation.description: When an attack with this weapon destroys a living enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 + 3 damage points from this model's battlegroup controller.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.description: This model can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.

doomDriver.name: Doom Driver
doomDriver.description: This weapon gains +1 to its damage rolls for each corpse token on this model.

doomsDay.name: Doom's Day
doomsDay.description: Dekathus gains five soul tokens. Additionally, cohort models in Dekathus' battlegroup currently in his control range gain Overtake. Doom's Day lasts for one round. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

dopamineBoost.name: Dopamine Boost
dopamineBoost.description: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

drag.name: Drag
drag.description: If this model hits an enemy model with an equal or smaller base with a basic attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved the hit model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.

dragBelow.name: Drag Below
dragBelow.description: During this model's activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it boxed an enemy warrior model, this model can use Drag Below. The boxed model is removed from play and this model can immediately make a full advance and then perform a Dig In special action, then its activation ends.

ebbAndFlow.name: Ebb and Flow
ebbAndFlow.description: On a direct hit, models hit that have been pushed by Tunneler this turn become knocked down.

electroLeap.name: Electro Leap
electroLeap.description: When a model is directly hit with a basic attack made with this weapon, you can have lightning arc to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that caused the leap.

empowerAction.name: Empower (★Action)
empowerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.

endorphinDump.name: Endorphin Dump
endorphinDump.description: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

enlivenAction.name: Enliven (★Action)
enlivenAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.

enrageAction.name: Enrage (★ Action)
enrageAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. Enrage lasts for one turn.

entropicForce.name: Entropic Force
entropicForce.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.description: This model gains an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against construct models.

evasive.name: Evasive
evasive.description: When this model is hit by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can advance up to 2".

exhaustFumes.name: Exhaust Fumes
exhaustFumes.description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

expendableAssetAction.name: Expendable Asset (★Action)
expendableAssetAction.description: RNG 3. Remove target friendly model from play. This model gains a mind token.

explosiveDecomposition.name: Explosive Decomposition
explosiveDecomposition.description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 corrosion damage roll and the Corrosion continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

extendedControlRange.name: Extended Control Range
extendedControlRange.description: When checking to see if this model is in its controller's control range, double the range.

featArcaneReaver.name: FEAT - Arcane Reaver
featArcaneReaver.description: Immediately remove any number of soul tokens, fury points, essence points, and focus points from non-Leader models in Hexeris' control range. For each token or point removed, place 1 fury point on Hexeris. Hexeris cannot exceed his current ARC in fury points as a result of Arcane Reaver.

featBlackGate.name: FEAT - Black Gate
featBlackGate.description: While in Scaverous' control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted magic attack rolls. When Scaverous casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When an enemy model casts a spell while in Scaverous' control range, increase the COST by 1. Black Gate lasts for one round.

featDarkSummons.name: FEAT - Dark Summons
featDarkSummons.description: Put a small-based Bane unit into play. Place each model completely within 3" of Goreshade.

featHellGate.name: FEAT - Hell Gate
featHellGate.description: Deneghra immediately gains seven soul tokens.

featShadowfall.name: FEAT - Shadowfall
featShadowfall.description: Models in Agathia's battlegroup currently in her control range are affected by Ghost Walk. Additionally, you can place each friendly faction Cohort model currently in Agathia's control range anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadowfall lasts for one turn.

featStrengthEternal.name: FEAT - Strength Eternal
featStrengthEternal.description: Remove d6 + 3 damage points from each friendly Faction construct model currently in Zaal's control range. While in Zaal's control range, friendly Faction construct models gain +3 ARM. Strength Eternal lasts for one round.

featVoidWind.name: FEAT - Void Wind
featVoidWind.description: While in Mordikaar's control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 DEF and Poltergeist. Void Wind lasts for one round.

featWhispersOfTorment.name: FEAT - Whispers of Torment
featWhispersOfTorment.description: While in Xekaar's control range, enemy models suffer -3 MAT, RAT, and THR. Additionally, affected models suffer -3 to their melee attack damage rolls. Whispers of Torment lasts for one round.

feignDeath.name: Feign Death
feignDeath.description: This model cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.

fieldMarshalBloodShadow.name: Field Marshal [Blood Shadow]
fieldMarshalBloodShadow.description: The melee weapons of warjacks in this model's battlegroup gain Blood Shadow.

fieldMarshalChanneler.name: Field Marshal [Channeler]
fieldMarshalChanneler.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Channeler.

fieldMarshalGangFighter.name: Field Marshal [Gang Fighter]
fieldMarshalGangFighter.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Gang Fighter. (When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.)

fieldMarshalPathfinder.name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder]
fieldMarshalPathfinder.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Pathfinder.

fieldMarshalReposition3.name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
fieldMarshalReposition3.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

fieldMarshalRetaliatoryStrike.name: Field Marshal [Retaliatory Strike]
fieldMarshalRetaliatoryStrike.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent's turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

fightToTheLast.name: Fight to the Last
fightToTheLast.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls against damaged models.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: This weapon becomes Sp 8, POW 12, and gains Continuous Effect: Fire and Damage Type: Fire for this attack.

flyingHigh.name: Flying High
flyingHigh.description: Ranged attacks targeting this model suffer -3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. This model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.

followUp.name: Follow Up
followUp.description: When this model slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.

forceAura.name: Force Aura
forceAura.description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and ARM against ranged attacks. Force Aura lasts for one round.

forceBarrier.name: Force Barrier
forceBarrier.description: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.

forcedReload1.name: Forced Reload [1]
forcedReload1.description: This model can be forced once during its activation to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

freeFall.name: Free Fall
freeFall.description: When a model with Flight is hit by this attack it becomes knocked down and loses Flight for one round.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: A model hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

fullAuto.name: Full Auto
fullAuto.description: Instead of making one attack with this weapon, this model can make d3 attacks. Do not choose an attack type when resolving these attacks.

fullBatteryFireAttack.name: Full Battery Fire (★ Attack)
fullBatteryFireAttack.description: This weapon becomes POW 20 for this attack. On a direct hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a damage roll with POW equal to the blast damage POW of this weapon. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the blast damage POW of this weapon.

fullBoar.name: Full Boar
fullBoar.description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

gang.name: Gang
gang.description: When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, this model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.

gatesOfHell.name: Gates of Hell
gatesOfHell.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which this model destroyed a living or undead enemy model with this weapon, this model can spend one soul token to be placed anywhere completely within 4" of its current location, then its activation ends.

ghostly.name: Ghostly
ghostly.description: A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

ghostShield.name: Ghost Shield
ghostShield.description: This model gains +1 ARM for each soul token currently on it.

ghostShot.name: Ghost Shot
ghostShot.description: This model ignores LOS, concealment, and cover when making attacks with this weapon.

girded.name: Girded
girded.description: This model and friendly models B2B with it gain Resistance: Blast.

gnawingPain.name: Gnawing Pain
gnawingPain.description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer -2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Gnawing Pain lasts for one round.

goreshadeTheBastardFeat.name: Dark Summons
goreshadeTheBastardFeat.description: Put a small-based Bane unit into play. Place each model completely within 3" of Goreshade.

grandSlam.name: Grand Slam
grandSlam.description: This model can make slam power attacks without spending a focus point. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

grantedBloodBound.name: Granted: Blood-Bound
grantedBloodBound.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Blood-Bound. (When a model with Blood-Bound destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of the attacking model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.)

grantedGang.name: Granted: Gang
grantedGang.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Gang. (When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, a model with Gang gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.)

grantedInspiration.name: Granted: Inspiration
grantedInspiration.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

grantedRelentlessCharge.name: Granted: Relentless Charge
grantedRelentlessCharge.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

grantedRise.name: Granted: Rise
grantedRise.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit that are knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase stand up.

grantedSetDefense.name: Granted: Set Defense
grantedSetDefense.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Set Defense.

grantedShieldGuard.name: Granted: Shield Guard
grantedShieldGuard.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

grantedTough.name: Granted: Tough
grantedTough.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Tough.

grapplingHook.name: Grappling Hook
grapplingHook.description: At the end this models activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

graveMist.name: Grave Mist
graveMist.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to give models in its unit +2 DEF for one round.

graveyardShift.name: Graveyard Shift
graveyardShift.description: Put a Mechanithrall Swarm unit into play. Place each model completely within 2" of

grievousWounds.name: Grievous Wounds
grievousWounds.description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

grimReturnsAction.name: Grim Returns (★Action)
grimReturnsAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly trooper model. If the model is in range, return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage point. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper model. Returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

guidanceAction.name: Guidance (★ Action)
guidanceAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

harmoniousExaltationAction.name: Harmonious Exaltation (★ Action)
harmoniousExaltationAction.description: RNG 5. Target this model's Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

healD31Action.name: Heal [d3+1] (★Action)
healD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

hellfireAttack.name: Hellfire (★ Attack)
hellfireAttack.description: Hellfire is a RNG 10, POW 14 arcane attack. Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

hellMarked.name: Hell Marked
hellMarked.description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

hexBlastAttack.name: Hex Blast (★Attack)
hexBlastAttack.description: Hex Blast is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/8 arcane attack. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

hormoneManipulation.name: Hormone Manipulation
hormoneManipulation.description: When this model begins its activation in Nostilla's control range, choose one of the following effects. Hormone Manipulation effects last for one round: Adrenal Surge - This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.) Dopamine Boost - This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".) Endorphin Dump - This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

huntingPackAradus.name: Hunting Pack [Aradus]
huntingPackAradus.description: This model gains a +1 cumulative bonus to melee attack and damage rolls for each other friendly Aradus warbeast with the target of this model's melee attack in its melee range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

hyperAggressive.name: Hyper-Aggressive
hyperAggressive.description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

immovableObject.name: Immovable Object
immovableObject.description: This model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

imperviousFlesh.name: Impervious Flesh
imperviousFlesh.description: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.

incendiary.name: Incendiary
incendiary.description: This attack causes fire damage, and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

inconsequential.name: Inconsequential
inconsequential.description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.description: The spellcaster gains Unyielding. Indomitable lasts for one round.

inflictPain.name: Inflict Pain
inflictPain.description: When it hits a warbeast with this weapon, this model can place 1 fury point on or remove 1 fury point from the warbeast.

inhumanResolve.name: Inhuman Resolve
inhumanResolve.description: When a friendly warrior model within 10" of this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can remove 1 damage point. When this model is disabled, it becomes knocked down instead of becoming boxed and its activation immediately ends. While this model is disabled, it cannot activate. If this model is disabled at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it is destroyed.

inscrutable.name: Inscrutable
inscrutable.description: Opponents cannot take control of this model.

invocationOfBitterestNightAction.name: Invocation of Bitterest Night (★Action)
invocationOfBitterestNightAction.description: This model gains Stealth and Black Mantle for one round. (While B2B with a model with Black Mantle, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.)

invocationOfDarkestNightAction.name: Invocation of Darkest Night (★ Action)
invocationOfDarkestNightAction.description: This model gains Mortal Fear. Invocation of Darkest Night lasts for one round.

journeymanCephalyxWarcaster.name: Journeyman Cephalyx Warcaster
journeymanCephalyxWarcaster.description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Healing, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model may allocate focus point to monstrosities in it's battlegroup as if they were a warjack. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

journeymanWarcaster.name: Journeyman Warcaster
journeymanWarcaster.description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

knockdown.name: Knockdown
knockdown.description: When a model is hit by an attack with this weapon, it becomes knocked down.

knowledgeOfTheDamned.name: Knowledge of the Damned
knowledgeOfTheDamned.description: When a model in this model's control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

lastWord.name: Last Word
lastWord.description: When this model is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.

leadershipBasilisks.name: Leadership [Basilisks]
leadershipBasilisks.description: When another friendly Basilisk model ends its activation while within 10" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that model.

leadershipConstruct.name: Leadership [Construct]
leadershipConstruct.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Construct models cannot become knocked down.

leadershipMechanithrallSwarm.name: Leadership [Mechanithrall Swarm]
leadershipMechanithrallSwarm.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Mechanithrall Swarm models gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

leadershipTitans.name: Leadership [Titans]
leadershipTitans.description: When a friendly non-Bronzeback Titan ends its activation within 5" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that Titan.

leadershipVoidSpirits.name: Leadership [Void Spirits]
leadershipVoidSpirits.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Void Spirits models gain Tough and Stealth and +1 to attack rolls.

lesserWarlock.name: Lesser Warlock
lesserWarlock.description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage. This model must have at least one warbeast in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

lifeDrinker.name: Life Drinker
lifeDrinker.description: When this model boxes a living enemy model with this weapon, this model can remove d3 damage points.

lightningStrike.name: Lightning Strike
lightningStrike.description: The spellcaster gains Sprint. Lightning Strike lasts for one turn.

limitedBattlegroupAberration.name: Limited Battlegroup [Aberration]
limitedBattlegroupAberration.description: The only cohort that can be in this model's battlegroup is Aberration.

limitedBattlegroupInvictus.name: Limited Battlegroup [Invictus]
limitedBattlegroupInvictus.description: The only warjack that can be in this model's battlegroup is Invictus.

limitedBattlegroupKythos.name: Limited Battlegroup [Kythos]
limitedBattlegroupKythos.description: The only Cohort models that can be in this model's battlegroup are Monstrosities and Cryx warjacks.

limitedBattlegroupWarBoarMmd47.name: Limited Battlegroup [War Boar MMD47]
limitedBattlegroupWarBoarMmd47.description: The only warbeast that can be in this model's battlegroup is War Boar MMD47.

loneGunman.name: Lone Gunman
loneGunman.description: When attacking with this weapon, this model cannot participate in combined ranged attacks.

longShadows.name: Long Shadows
longShadows.description: When one or more living enemy models are destroyed by an arcane attack while in this model's control range, this model gains one focus or fury point.

lordArbiterHexerisFeat.name: Arcane Reaver
lordArbiterHexerisFeat.description: Immediately remove any number of soul tokens, fury points, essence points, and focus points from non-Leader models in Hexeris' control range. For each token or point removed, place 1 fury point on Hexeris. Hexeris cannot exceed his current ARC in fury points as a result of Arcane Reaver.

lordExhumatorScaverousFeat.name: Black Gate
lordExhumatorScaverousFeat.description: While in Scaverous' control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted magic attack rolls. When Scaverous casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When an enemy model casts a spell while in Scaverous' control range, increase the COST by 1. Black Gate lasts for one round.

lordTyrantZaadeshFeat.name: Scorpion's Sting
lordTyrantZaadeshFeat.description: While in Zaadesh's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 MAT and +2 to their melee attack damage rolls and Defensive Strike. Scorpion's Sting lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement, or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

lostSouls.name: Lost Souls
lostSouls.description: At the start of this model's activation, if there are no living non-soulless enemy models within 12" of this model, this model gains d3 soul tokens.

lurker.name: Lurker
lurker.description: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Bushwhack. Lurker lasts for one turn.

maddening.name: Maddening
maddening.description: Enemy warbeasts currently within 6" of this model gain 1 fury point.

mageStatic.name: Mage Static
mageStatic.description: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and -3 RNG.

magicAbility.name: Magic Ability
magicAbility.description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

maltreatment.name: Maltreatment
maltreatment.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove 1 fury point from a warbeast in its battlegroup that is in its control range and add 1 fury point to its own current total. The warbeast suffers d3 damage points.

manCatcher.name: Man Catcher
manCatcher.description: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers -2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model's melee range for one round.

manifestControl.name: Manifest Control
manifestControl.description: After this model casts a spell, it can spend a mind token to cast a spell it has not already cast this turn.

marionetteAttack.name: Marionette (★Attack)
marionetteAttack.description: Marionette is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Target enemy model/unit. You can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Marionette expires. Marionette lasts for one round.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.description: When damaging a warjack or warbeast with a ranged attack, choose which column or branch suffers damage.

massDelusion.name: Mass Delusion
massDelusion.description: While in Kythos's control range, enemy models suffer -2 to their attack rolls against friendly Faction non-Incorporeal models. Additionally, friendly Faction non-Incorporeal models in Kythos's control range gain Dodge. Mass Delusion lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

medicateD3Action.name: Medicate [d3] (★ Action)
medicateD3Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

mentalReservoir.name: Mental Reservoir
mentalReservoir.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend mind tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

mercenaryHouseKallyssNecrofactoriumAndRe.name: Mercenary [House Kallyss, Necrofactorium and Reaper Covenant]
mercenaryHouseKallyssNecrofactoriumAndRe.description: This model will work for House Kallyss, Necrofactorium and Reaper Covenant.

mercenaryHouseKallyssNecrofactoriumAndSe.name: Mercenary [House Kallyss, Necrofactorium, and Sea Raiders]
mercenaryHouseKallyssNecrofactoriumAndSe.description: This model will work for House Kallyss, Necrofactorium, and Sea Raiders.

mercenaryNecrofactoriumSeaRaidersReaperC.name: Mercenary [Necrofactorium, Sea Raiders, Reaper Covenant, and Dark Operations]
mercenaryNecrofactoriumSeaRaidersReaperC.description: This model will work for Necrofactorium, Sea Raiders, Reaper Covenant, and Dark Operations.

mindBurst.name: Mind Burst
mindBurst.description: Once per turn at any time during this model's activation, you can choose one grunt in this unit. Enemy models within 2" of the chosen grunt suffer an unboostable POW 12 magic blast damage roll, then the chosen grunt is removed from play.

mortalFear.name: Mortal Fear
mortalFear.description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models suffer -2 to damage rolls.

multipleHeads5.name: Multiple Heads [5]
multipleHeads5.description: This model can make 5 initial attacks each Combat Action, using any combination of Acid Spray and Bite attacks. This model loses one initial attack for each of its aspects that are currently crippled. This model cannot be forced to make additional Acid Spray attacks.

necrosurgeryD31Action.name: Necrosurgery [d3+1] (★Action)
necrosurgeryD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly undead Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

necrotheurgy.name: Necrotheurgy
necrotheurgy.description: Once during its activation this model can spend a soul token to cast a spell without spending focus.

ornery.name: Ornery
ornery.description: The spellcaster gains Retaliatory Strike. Ornery lasts for one round.

overtake.name: Overtake
overtake.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".

painMaddened.name: Pain Maddened
painMaddened.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, it gains +2 SPD for one round.

painResponse.name: Pain Response
painResponse.description: While damaged, this model can charge and make power attacks without being forced.

paralysis.name: Paralysis
paralysis.description: A living model hit by this weapon has its base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. Paralysis lasts for one round.

phantomSeeker.name: Phantom Seeker
phantomSeeker.description: This model ignores LOS, concealment, and cover when making attacks with this weapon.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against living models.

polarityField.name: Polarity Field
polarityField.description: This model cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.description: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.

powerfulAttack.name: Powerful Attack
powerfulAttack.description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can spend 1 focus point or be forced to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.

powerOfDeathAction.name: Power of Death (★Action)
powerOfDeathAction.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly undead models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Power of Death lasts for one turn.

prey.name: Prey
prey.description: After deployment but before the first player's turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit's prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.

primalMagic.name: Primal Magic
primalMagic.description: This model can be forced to cast the animus of any friendly Faction warbeast within 5" of it as if the animus were its own.

primusJalaamFeat.name: Hide in Sight
primusJalaamFeat.description: When an enemy model makes an attack roll against a friendly Faction model in Jalaam's control range, the enemy model rolls one less die. Hide in Sight lasts for one round.

psychicAssaultAttack.name: Psychic Assault (★Attack)
psychicAssaultAttack.description: Psychic Assault is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. This attack ignores LOS.

psychicOverload.name: Psychic Overload
psychicOverload.description: Psychic Overload is a RNG 8, POW 13 arcane attack. When this attack boxes a living or undead enemy model, you can take control of it and make a 3" advance. Then, enemy models within 2" of it suffer a POW 10 unboostable magical blast damage roll. These damage rolls are not from an attack. The boxed model is then removed from play.

psychicOverloadAttack.name: Psychic Overload (★Attack)
psychicOverloadAttack.description: Psychic Overload is a RNG 8, POW 13 arcane attack. When this attack boxes a living or undead enemy model, you can take control of it and make a 3" advance. Then, enemy models within 2" of it suffer a POW 10 unboostable magical blast damage roll. These damage rolls are not from an attack. The boxed model is then removed from play.

psychoVenom.name: Psycho Venom
psychoVenom.description: When a living or undead enemy model is boxed by this attack, you can choose to take control of it. If you do, remove 1 damage point from it, causing it to no longer be boxed. For the rest of the turn, this model's battlegroup controller can channel spells through the affected model as if it were a model in its battlegroup with the Arc Node advantage. The affected model cannot activate. At the end of this turn, the affected model is destroyed.

puppetMasterAction.name: Puppet Master (★ Action)
puppetMasterAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, you can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Puppet Master expires. Puppet Master lasts for one round.

quickDraw.name: Quick Draw
quickDraw.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model within 12" of this model directly hits a friendly model within 3" of this model with a non-spray ranged attack, this model can make a ranged attack roll against the enemy model. If this attack roll hits, the enemy ranged attack automatically misses.

rapidHealing.name: Rapid Healing
rapidHealing.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.

rapidStrike.name: Rapid Strike
rapidStrike.description: This model can make one additional melee attack each Combat Action.

reciprocate.name: Reciprocate
reciprocate.description: When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack targeting the attacking model.

reduceReuseRecycle.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
reduceReuseRecycle.description: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller Cohort model that was part of Mortenebra's battlegroup to play. Place it within 3" of her. The Cohort model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action this turn.

regenerationD33.name: Regeneration [d3 +3]
regenerationD33.description: This model can be forced to remove d3 +3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

reload1.name: Reload [1]
reload1.description: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

repairable.name: Repairable
repairable.description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

repairD31Action.name: Repair [d3 +1] (★ Action)
repairD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

repairD33Action.name: Repair [d3+3] (★Action)
repairD33Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 + 3 damage points from it.

repairD6Action.name: Repair [d6] (★ Action)
repairD6Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

reposition3.name: Reposition [3"]
reposition3.description: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

reposition5.name: Reposition [5"]
reposition5.description: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.

repulsion.name: Repulsion
repulsion.description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 3" directly away from it in the order you choose.

resourceful.name: Resourceful
resourceful.description: This model can upkeep spells on models in its battlegroup without spending focus or fury points.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.description: If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can advance up to 3" and make one basic melee attack.

retaliatoryStrike.name: Retaliatory Strike
retaliatoryStrike.description: If this model is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent's turn, after that attack is resolved this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. This model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.

righteousVengeance.name: Righteous Vengeance
righteousVengeance.description: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of this model during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase this model can advance up to 3" and make one basic attack.

rush.name: Rush
rush.description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and gains Pathfinder. Rush lasts for one turn.

sacrificialPawnImmortal.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Immortal]
sacrificialPawnImmortal.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Immortal model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

sacrificialPawnMonstrosity.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Monstrosity]
sacrificialPawnMonstrosity.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Monstrosity within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

salvageHarvester.name: Salvage Harvester
salvageHarvester.description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3+3 damage points from this model.

sandStorm.name: Sand Storm
sandStorm.description: When a friendly model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 5" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Sand Storm lasts for one round.

selfPropelled.name: Self-Propelled
selfPropelled.description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD + d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model it explodes with the same effect as Explosive Decomposition and is removed from play.

serpentsCoil.name: Serpent's Coil
serpentsCoil.description: Once per game at any time during its unit's activation, this model can use Serpent's Coil. For one round, models in this unit gain Defensive Strike.

setDefense.name: Set Defense
setDefense.description: Models suffer -2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

shadowBind.name: Shadow Bind
shadowBind.description: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers -3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

shadowFire.name: Shadow Fire
shadowFire.description: A model hit by this attack does not block LOS for one turn.

shadowGate.name: Shadow Gate
shadowGate.description: Once per turn during its activation immediately after resolving an attack in which it hit an enemy model with a melee attack, this model can spend 1 corpse or soul token to be placed completely within 2" of its current location.

shieldGuard.name: Shield Guard
shieldGuard.description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

shieldWall.name: Shield Wall
shieldWall.description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

sideStep.name: Side Step
sideStep.description: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.

siegeWeapon.name: Siege Weapon
siegeWeapon.description: This weapon gains an additional die to its damage rolls against buildings and huge-based models.

sigilOfPowerAction.name: Sigil of Power (★Action)
sigilOfPowerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.description: A model hit by this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

skewer.name: Skewer
skewer.description: When this weapon damages an enemy model with an equal or smaller base, immediately after the attack is resolved the damaged model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.

skullsOfHate.name: Skulls of Hate
skullsOfHate.description: This model is a spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model gains 1 soul token for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

slammer.name: Slammer
slammer.description: This model can make slam power attacks without being forced. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

sleepwalker.name: Sleepwalker
sleepwalker.description: This attack causes no damage. Instead, a living warrior model hit by this attack becomes stationary for one round. On a critical hit on a non-Leader living enemy warrior model, before it becomes stationary you take control of the model hit. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic attack, then the enemy model reverts to your opponent’s control and becomes stationary for one round.

smokeBombsAction.name: Smoke Bombs (★Action)
smokeBombsAction.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.

snacking.name: Snacking
snacking.description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

soulBondage.name: Soul Bondage
soulBondage.description: Once per round when a living enemy warrior model is destroyed within 2" of this model, you can replace the destroyed model with a Machine Wraith solo. The destroyed model is removed from play and does not provide a soul token.

soulChambered1.name: Soul Chambered [1]
soulChambered1.description: This model can spend 1 essence point or soul token to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

soulGenerator.name: Soul Generator
soulGenerator.description: At the start of this model's activation, you can spend soul tokens on this model to give it 1 focus point for each token spent.

soulMastery.name: Soul Mastery
soulMastery.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend soul tokens to use one of the following effects for each token spent: Dark Whispers or Vengeful Spirits.

soulPhase.name: Soul Phase
soulPhase.description: This model can spend a soul token at any time during its activation to gain Incorporeal for one turn.

soulPowered.name: Soul-Powered
soulPowered.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

soulTakerBodyCount.name: Soul Taker: Body Count
soulTakerBodyCount.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for Strength of Death or Dark Blessing.

soulTakerCollector.name: Soul Taker: Collector
soulTakerCollector.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

soulTakerCullSoul.name: Soul Taker: Cull Soul
soulTakerCullSoul.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. After this model replenishes its focus during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 focus point.

soulTakerExhumator.name: Soul Taker: Exhumator
soulTakerExhumator.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within this model's control range, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model's activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

soulTakerReclaim.name: Soul Taker: Reclaim
soulTakerReclaim.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while in this model's control range, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. After this model replenishes its focus points or leeches fury during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 focus or fury point.

soulTakerRequiem.name: Soul Taker: Requiem
soulTakerRequiem.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for various abilities.

soulTakerSoulCage.name: Soul Taker: Soul Cage
