soulTakerSoulCage.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time.

soulTakerSpectralScavenger.name: Soul Taker: Spectral Scavenger
soulTakerSpectralScavenger.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed in this model's control range, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following: Strength of Death - During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent. Knowledge of the Damned - When a model in this model's control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

soulTap.name: Soul Tap
soulTap.description: If this model is in its Leader's control range during your Control Phase, the Leader can spend soul tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.

soulTransferAction.name: Soul Transfer (★Action)
soulTransferAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

soulVessel.name: Soul Vessel
soulVessel.description: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.

soulWeaver.name: Soul Weaver
soulWeaver.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove soul tokens from one friendly Faction model within 10" of it and place them on itself.

spareParts.name: Spare Parts
spareParts.description: When a warjack is destroyed within 5" of this model, it gains one scrap token. This model can have up to three scrap tokens at any time. Before making a repair roll, this model can spend one scrap token to add +2 to its roll.

spectralVortex.name: Spectral Vortex
spectralVortex.description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

spellSlaveActionOrAttack.name: Spell Slave (★Action or ★Attack)
spellSlaveActionOrAttack.description: This model must be in its Leader's control range to make the Spell Slave special action. When it does, it casts one of the spells on its Leader's card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL. When casting an offensive spell, Spell Slave is an arcane attack.

spellWard.name: Spell Ward
spellWard.description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

spinyGrowth.name: Spiny Growth
spinyGrowth.description: The spellcaster gains +2 ARM. If a non-warrior model hits the spellcaster with a melee attack, the attacking model suffers d3 damage points immediately after the attack is resolved unless the spellcaster was destroyed or removed from play by the attack. Spiny Growth lasts for one round.

spiritDriven.name: Spirit-Driven
spiritDriven.description: At the beginning of this model's activation, it can spend one soul token to gain +2 SPD that activation.

spiritGuideAction.name: Spirit Guide (★ Action)
spiritGuideAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model with Soul Taker: Requiem. If the model is in range, move any number of soul tokens to it from this model.

spiritSiphon.name: Spirit Siphon
spiritSiphon.description: When this model makes an attack, it can suffer 1 damage to remain incorporeal.

spiritualAffliction.name: Spiritual Affliction
spiritualAffliction.description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models cannot cast spells. Spiritual Affliction lasts for one round.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.description: At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.

steady.name: Steady
steady.description: This model cannot become knocked down.

stonesWrathAction.name: Stones' Wrath (★ Action)
stonesWrathAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls this turn.

strengthOfDeath.name: Strength of Death
strengthOfDeath.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

stygianAbyssAttack.name: Stygian Abyss (★Attack)
stygianAbyssAttack.description: Stygian Abyss is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind can not make ranged or magic attacks, suffers -4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

sucker.name: Sucker!
sucker.description: If this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

supremeArchdominaMakedaFeat.name: Instruments of War
supremeArchdominaMakedaFeat.description: While in Makeda's control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down. Instruments of War lasts for one round.

sustainedAttack.name: Sustained Attack
sustainedAttack.description: During this model's activation, when it makes an attack with this weapon against the last model hit by the weapon this activation, the attack automatically hits.

swiftHunter.name: Swift Hunter
swiftHunter.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

takeUp.name: Take Up
takeUp.description: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.

telekineticShift.name: Telekinetic Shift
telekineticShift.description: Place the spellcaster completely within 5" of its current location.

telekineticShiftAction.name: Telekinetic Shift (★Action)
telekineticShiftAction.description: Place the spellcaster completely within 5" of its current location.

telekineticTide.name: Telekinetic Tide
telekineticTide.description: Push each enemy non-Leader model currently in Thexus’ control range 2" in any direction.

telemetry.name: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.

thrallBomb.name: Thrall Bomb
thrallBomb.description: When this model is disabled, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 8 blast damage roll, then this model is removed from play.

thresher.name: Thresher
thresher.description: (★ Attack) This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

thresherAttack.name: Thresher (★Attack)
thresherAttack.description: This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon's melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

threshingMaw.name: Threshing Maw
threshingMaw.description: After this model is placed by Tunneler but before pushing enemy models as a result of Tunneler, enemy models within 2" of this model suffer an unboostable POW 12 melee damage roll.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.description: Enemy models hit are pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.

trueMercenary.name: True Mercenary
trueMercenary.description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

tuneUpAction.name: Tune Up (★Action)
tuneUpAction.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the model expire, and it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

tunneler.name: Tunneler
tunneler.description: This model can forfeit its Normal Movement to be placed anywhere completely within 10" of its current location. Colossal Movement does not apply to this model while resolving this rule. After it has been placed, enemy models within 2" of this model can be pushed up to 3" directly away from this model in the order you choose.

unhallowed.name: Unhallowed
unhallowed.description: While within 10", friendly Faction undead models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attacks.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.description: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.

vampiricHarvest.name: Vampiric Harvest
vampiricHarvest.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed in this model's control range, a model in this model's battlegroup that is in its control range can remove 1 damage point.

vaultOfTheFaithful.name: Vault of the Faithful
vaultOfTheFaithful.description: During your Maintenance Phase, you can remove up to three soul tokens from this model to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within 12" of this model and completely within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.description: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. Each model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3". After all models in the unit have moved, each model can then make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

vengefulSpirits.name: Vengeful Spirits
vengefulSpirits.description: Choose a cohort model in this model's battlegroup within 10" of it. That cohort model gains up to 3 focus points.

veteranLeaderConstructWarrior.name: Veteran Leader [Construct Warrior]
veteranLeaderConstructWarrior.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Construct warrior models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderPaingiverBloodrunners.name: Veteran Leader [Paingiver Bloodrunners]
veteranLeaderPaingiverBloodrunners.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Paingiver Bloodrunner models gain +1 to attack rolls.

viceClamp.name: Vice Clamp
viceClamp.description: An enemy model with an equal or smaller base hit by this weapon suffers -2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model's melee range for one round.

vitalizer.name: Vitalizer
vitalizer.description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

vitalizerAction.name: Vitalizer (★Action)
vitalizerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

vitalMagic.name: Vital Magic
vitalMagic.description: When a spell or special rule would cause one or more of this model's upkeep spells to expire, this model can keep one or more of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points for each spell kept in play.

voidBlast.name: Void Blast
voidBlast.description: This weapon becomes AOE 2, POW 14/8 for this attack. Models destroyed by this attack are removed from play.

voidBringer.name: Void Bringer
voidBringer.description: This model can use Void Bringer once per game at any time during its unit's activation. When this model uses Void Bringer, return d3 + 1 destroyed troopers to this unit. Place the returned troopers completely within 3" of this model. Returned troopers must forfeit their Combat Actions this activation.

voidDisruptor.name: Void Disruptor
voidDisruptor.description: The first time each turn each enemy warjack or monstrosity ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one or more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 focus. The first time each turn each enemy horrors ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one or more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 essence. The first time each turn each enemy warbeast ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one or more models with Void Disruptor, it gains 1 fury. While the Hellraker has two functional Void Disruptors, enemy cohorts are affected by this ability within 6" rather than 3".

voidSeerMordikaarFeat.name: Void Wind
voidSeerMordikaarFeat.description: While in Mordikaar's control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 DEF and Poltergeist. Void Wind lasts for one round.

voidWalk.name: Void Walk
voidWalk.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed a living or undead enemy model with an attack during its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 8" of its current location.

volumeFire.name: Volume Fire
volumeFire.description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

weaponsPlatform.name: Weapons Platform
weaponsPlatform.description: As long as a model has two options that include Weapons Platform special rule this model gains the Gunfighter advantage.

wingsOfDeath.name: Wings of Death
wingsOfDeath.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Construct warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Incorporeal for one round. If the model is in range and is a trooper model, the models in its unit also gain Incorporeal for one round.

witchMark.name: Witch Mark
witchMark.description: If this attack hits an enemy model during this model's activation, until the end of that activation this model can target and automatically hit that enemy model with spells, ignoring RNG and LOS.

wraithbinder.name: Wraithbinder
wraithbinder.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Incorporeal models gain +3 ARM.

wraithShot.name: Wraith Shot
wraithShot.description: When this model makes an attack with this weapon, it can spend a soul token to use Wraith Shot. If it does, it ignores LOS, concealment, and cover when making the attack. Attack and damage rolls resulting from the attack are boosted.

wrathOfLyliss.name: Wrath of Lyliss
wrathOfLyliss.description: Nekane can suffer one damage point to cast a spell instead of paying the COST of the spell in focus points. Each spell can be cast once as a result of Wrath of Lyliss. Additionally, Nekane can suffer one damage point to boost an attack or damage roll instead of spending a focus point. Wrath of Lyliss lasts for one round.

xerxisFuryOfHalaakFeat.name: Hand of the Ancients
xerxisFuryOfHalaakFeat.description: All models are considered to be in Xerxis' control range. Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. For each of those rolls, discard one die of your choice. Hand of the Ancients lasts for one turn.

zaalTheAncestralAdvocateFeat.name: Strength Eternal
zaalTheAncestralAdvocateFeat.description: Remove d6 + 3 damage points from each friendly Faction construct model currently in Zaal's control range. While in Zaal's control range, friendly Faction construct models gain +3 ARM. Strength Eternal lasts for one round.
